scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hey hey. I don't have time for chit-chat, I'm a pretty busy guy. There's all these Merchants working hard to become Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
喂喂，我可沒空閒聊，忙著呢。
這麼多商人，都在努力成為鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Wait a minute, I think I've met you before.
Ummm.....
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
等等，好像以前見過你。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you the one who broke my weapon and ran away? Or are you the one who tortured me so that I'd forge a weapon for you? Why can't I remember?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
你是那個弄壞我的武器然後逃跑的人嗎？還是那個折磨我，逼我為你打造武器的人？我怎麼想不起來了？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
.......
I can't remember who you are for the life of me. Is this deja vu?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
...
怎麼也想不起你是誰，是似曾相識的感覺嗎？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Argh!! This is really bugging me! But still, I can sense that there's something special about you. Oh well, whatever. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
啊！！真讓人煩躁！不過，感覺你確實有些特別。
算了，不管了，祝你今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Welcome!
We are Workers of Steel,
the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
歡迎！我們是鋼鐵工匠——鐵匠公會。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
We pour the fervor
and passion of our souls into
our craft. Our skills of melting metal into new weapons
and tools is truly a form of art!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
我們將心中的熱忱與激情傾注於技藝。
熔煉金屬，打造新的武器和工具，這本身就是一門藝術！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You... look like a stranger. But somehow it seems that you're related to our guild. Haha~
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
你...看著眼生，卻總覺得和我們公會有些關係。
哈哈~我說得對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh~
what a very
pretty lady!
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
哦~真是位漂亮的姑娘！
想成為鐵匠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
想成為鐵匠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
First, you must become a Merchant before you can become a Blacksmith. Go to the city of Alberta to learn the Merchant trade.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
首先，你必須成為商人，然後才能成為鐵匠。去艾爾貝塔學習商人的技藝吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh, are you interested in having a weapon forged? I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I actually have a lot of business to attend to.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
哦，想請人打造武器？
抱歉讓你失望了，我現在還有一大堆事要忙。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh...
There's not much we can offer you here. And you can't really help out around here unless you know how to make stuff...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
哦...這裡沒什麼能幫到你的。
不會製作東西的話，你也幫不上什麼忙...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh? What's a magic user doing here? I'm surprised. Usually this kind of rough work is beneath you intellectual types.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
哦？會魔法的人怎麼來了？真意外。
你們這些有學問的人，通常不屑於幹這種粗活吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Am I correct in assuming you're a member of the Clergy? Would you please bless me before you leave!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
哦！我猜得沒錯的話，你是神職人員吧？在你離開之前，請為我祝福一下！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry...
But there really isn't anything for you to steal here. Well, there are the Daggers we keep in the back, but...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
抱歉...這裡真沒什麼好偷的。
倒是後面放著些短劍，不過...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
So how's the pharmacy business going on recently?
Well, my forging business does not seem to grow any longer.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
最近藥劑生意怎麼樣？
我的鍛造生意，倒是沒什麼起色了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Long time no see.
Have you come to purchase supplies from Christopher? These days I'm stuck behind this desk. My body's itching to strike the ol' anvil.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
哦！好久不見。
來找克里斯托弗買材料？
最近我整天被困在這張桌子後，早就手癢，想回去敲鐵砧了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
技能點沒用完，不能轉職為鐵匠。
好好分配完技能點，再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Why don't you stop struggling
to make zeny as a Merchant and
join the elite Blacksmith class?
If you're interested, fill out this application with your name
and Job Level.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
別再當商人辛苦賺Zeny了，來成為精英鐵匠吧？
有興趣的話，就填好這張申請表，寫上名字和職業等級。

scripts.text: Fill out Application.
scripts.translation: 填寫申請表

scripts.text: What are the requirements?
scripts.translation: 有什麼要求？

scripts.text: Um, I need to think about it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
技能點沒用完，不能轉職為鐵匠。
好好分配完技能點，再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Looks like you
meet the Job Level
Requirement.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
嗯...看來你的職業等級符合要求。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You see, we don't accept just anybody into our guild. First, we only accept experienced Merchants with a true desire to become great Blacksmiths. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
我們公會可不是誰都收。
首先，得是經驗豐富、一心想成為優秀鐵匠的商人。
讓我看看...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Shuffling of papers*^000000

[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
One of our Blacksmiths in Einbech, ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 has sent us word that he's short on help. Your first test of character will be to help him out.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
嗯...艾音貝赫的鐵匠^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000來信，說缺人幫忙。
第一項品行考驗，就是去幫他。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Be careful
and good luck!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
小心點，祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm, it seems that you lack experience as a Merchant. We require that you are at least Job Level 40, you see.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
嗯，商人經驗還不夠。
職業等級至少得達到40級才行。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I feel bad turning you away after you've come so far, but rules are rules. Sorry to disappoint you, but we'll welcome you back once you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
讓你大老遠來卻空手而歸，我也過意不去，不過規矩就是規矩。
抱歉讓你失望了，準備好了再來，我們隨時歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You want to know our requirements? First, you need to have Job Level 40 or higher as a Merchant. Second, you need to pass a test that will be given by the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
想知道轉職條件？
首先，商人職業等級至少40級。
其次，通過鐵匠公會的測試。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
The test may consist of difficult tasks, but it's definitely not impossible. You will need to deliver certain items to different areas around the world
to complete the test.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
測試裡會有些困難的任務，但絕不是做不到。
你需要把指定物品送到世界各地，才能完成測試。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Well, I hope
to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
嗯...希望還能見到你。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You haven't left yet?
Go to Einbech and find ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000. Finish helping him out, and when you're done, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
你還沒走嗎？
去艾音貝赫找^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000。幫他完成工作，結束後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Was the work you did for ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 to your liking? He's known for being pretty exacting...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
給^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000幫忙，感覺怎麼樣？
他可是出了名的要求嚴格...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Great job!!
You have passed
the first test...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
幹得漂亮！！第一項測試通過了...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hm? You look surprised.
I guess you didn't know that there's more than one test. 
Haha, but don't worry, you are not going to travel that far.
Please go talk to the guildsman inside the building for more details about your next test.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
咦？你看起來很驚訝。
看來你不知道測試不止一個。
哈哈，不過別擔心，你不需要跑那麼遠。
請去樓裡找公會成員，瞭解下一次測試的詳細資訊。

scripts.text: I want to change my job quickly! But...oh well.
scripts.translation: 我想快點轉職！不過...算了

scripts.text: Grrr! Enough is enough!
scripts.translation: 哼！受夠了！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry, but I'm sure you understand, right? We can't just casually accept anybody into
our guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
抱歉，不過你也能理解吧？
我們不能隨隨便便就讓人加入公會！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
If we don't keep our standards,
we won't be able to maintain the respectability of the Blacksmith Guild!
We can't embarass our guild in this manner! *Ahem* Anyway, you talk to the guildsman inside the building now.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
不堅持標準，怎麼維護鐵匠公會的聲譽！
不能讓公會這樣丟臉！*咳*
總之，現在去找樓裡的公會成員吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you saying you're going
to quit the application process? That's an insult to our guild!
Get out of here! With that kind of attitude, you can forget becoming a member of the Blacksmith Guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
你是說，要放棄申請？這是在侮辱公會！
給我出去！這種態度，別想加入鐵匠公會！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You have no spirit!
If you can't endure this, you'll never be a Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
你毫無鬥志！
如果你連這點都堅持不了，就永遠成不了鐵匠！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Um? Haven't you talk to the guildsman yet?
If you haven't, I suggest you to do so as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
嗯？你還沒找公會成員談過嗎？
如果沒有的話，我建議你儘快去辦。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You are on a riding pet, so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
你正騎著寵物，無法轉職。
請卸下坐騎後再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Excellent, I can tell by the twinkle in your eye that you were successful. I can now bestow upon you the gift of the smithing, the art of the Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
很好，看你眼中的光芒，就知道成功了。
現在，我可以授予你鐵匠的鍛造技藝了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Always remember that we are creators, and artists over metals. Be wary that you do not fall into the pitfalls of selfishness
and greed.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
永遠記住，我們是創造者，是以金屬為媒介的藝術家。
別陷入自私和貪婪。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Here is a little
gift to mark the
beginning of your
life as a Blacksmith.
Congratulations!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒂雷根]
這是一份小禮物，以紀念你鐵匠生涯的開始。
恭喜！！！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hello there!
I'm ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000,
a Blacksmith by trade.
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你好！我是^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000，做鐵匠的。
很高興認識你！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Oh ho ho!
You're a Merchant!
Excellent! I was
in need of some help!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
哦呵呵！你是商人！
太好了，我正缺人幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
But, of course,
I wouldn't bother you
if you're busy. Go along
your way if you must~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不過，你要是忙，我就不打擾了。
有事要辦，就先去吧~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
After all...
I should know
how it's like
to be busy~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
畢竟...忙起來是什麼滋味，我可太清楚了~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Am I correct in assuming you are the help sent by the Blacksmith Guild? There aren't many trustyworthy people I can hire to help me, so I'm always
short on help.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我猜得沒錯的話，你就是鐵匠公會派來的幫手吧？我很少能僱到值得信賴的人幫忙，所以總是人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm, in any case,
you are the help that was sent, right? Okay, I have some work for you that must be handled
right away!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯，總之，你就是派來的幫手，對吧？
好，有些工作得請你馬上處理！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Some time ago, I had a boy working for me who had no experience and bought the wrong supplies! It was terrible...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不久前，我僱了一個沒有經驗的男孩，結果他買錯了材料！太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Anyone would hate to lose money through a foolish mistake like that. However, I have a slightly more difficult job for you.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
誰都不願意因為這種糊塗事虧錢。
不過，我交給你的工作會稍微難一些。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
However, I want to make sure that you have some basic knowledge as a Merchant. I'd like to ask you some questions, if that's okay.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
先確認一下，你是否具備商人的基礎知識。
不介意的話，我問你幾個問題。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Um, can I have some time to prepare?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以花點時間準備一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
So, have you
studied a little
more this time?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
那麼，這次多學了些知識嗎？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I admit that it's pretty unreasonable to expect anyone to get a perfect score the first time around, so I'll give you
a little break...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
第一次就要求人人拿滿分，確實不太合理。
所以，這次放寬一點...

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You can miss
one problem!
Alright, let's start
with the questions~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
可以錯一道題！
好，開始提問~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
1. Which one of the following regions is matched incorrectly
with its specialty item?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
1. 以下哪個地區與特產的配對有誤？

scripts.text: Morocc - Thief Clothes
scripts.translation: 夢羅克 - 盜賊之衣

scripts.text: Alberta - Two Hand Axe
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔 - 雙手斧

scripts.text: Comodo - Berserk Potion
scripts.translation: 克魔島 - 菠色克藥水

scripts.text: Alberta - Swordmace
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔 - 尖刃鐵錘

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
2. What status can
be inflicted with the
^8E6B23Hammer Fall^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
2. ^8E6B23大地之擊^000000技能能造成哪種異常狀態？

scripts.text: Stun
scripts.translation: 眩暈

scripts.text: Blind
scripts.translation: 黑暗

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text: Sleep
scripts.translation: 睡眠

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
3. Which one of the following skills cannot be performed
by a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
3. 以下哪個技能是商人無法使用的？

scripts.text: Vending
scripts.translation: 露天商店

scripts.text: Discount
scripts.translation: 低價買進

scripts.text: Overcharge
scripts.translation: 高價賣出

scripts.text: Increase AGI
scripts.translation: 加速術

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
4. Where can you find a store
that sells Blue Gemstones?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
4. 哪裡的商店出售藍色魔力礦石？

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 夢羅克

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
5. Where is the
Tool Dealer
located in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
5. 吉芬的工具店位於哪裡？

scripts.text: 8 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城鎮廣場的8點鐘方向

scripts.text: 11 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城鎮廣場的11點鐘方向

scripts.text: 6 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城鎮廣場的6點鐘方向

scripts.text: 5 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城鎮廣場的5點鐘方向

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
6. Which weapon
cannot be used
by a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
6. 商人無法使用哪種武器？

scripts.text: Stiletto
scripts.translation: 雙刃短劍

scripts.text: Ring Pommel Saber
scripts.translation: 圓柄馬刀

scripts.text: Chain
scripts.translation: 鎖鏈

scripts.text: Bible
scripts.translation: 聖經

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
7. Which one of the following
has the highest defense rate?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
7. 以下哪件裝備的防禦力最高？

scripts.text: Panties
scripts.translation: 內褲

scripts.text: Mink Coat
scripts.translation: 毛皮大衣

scripts.text: Wooden Mail
scripts.translation: 木製盔甲

scripts.text: Silk Robe
scripts.translation: 絲質外袍

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
8. For Level 3 weapons,
what is the ^8E6B23Safe^000000 limit
for upgrading?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
8. 3級武器的^8E6B23安全^000000精煉上限是多少？

scripts.text: up to + 3
scripts.translation: 最高+3

scripts.text: up to + 4
scripts.translation: 最高+4

scripts.text: up to + 5
scripts.translation: 最高+5

scripts.text: up to + 6
scripts.translation: 最高+6

scripts.text:
9. What item
can be made using
the ^8E6B23Trunks^000000 item?
scripts.translation: 9. 使用^8E6B23瑪哪樹枝^000000可以製作出什麼物品？

scripts.text: Sakkat
scripts.translation: 草帽

scripts.text: Ghost Bandana
scripts.translation: 亡者髮箍

scripts.text: Majestic Goat
scripts.translation: 山羊頭盔

scripts.text: Antler

[Geschupenschte]
Hmmm...?
Have you
completed
the delivery?
Let's see that receipt~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯...？
貨送到了嗎？
讓我看看收據~

scripts.text: Yes sir, here it is.
scripts.translation: 是的，先生，收據在這裡

scripts.text: Receipt? I, uh, have it somewhere.
scripts.translation: 收據？呃，我放哪兒了來著

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Oh ho ho~
Great!
You're truly
a great Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
哦呵呵~
太好了！
你真是個出色的商人！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Good job!
Return to ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000 in Einbroch, the guy you first met when you applied for the Blacksmith job.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
幹得好！
回艾音布羅克找^8E6B23阿爾蒂雷根^000000吧，就是你申請轉職鐵匠時最先見到的那個人。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I have faith that you
will be a great Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我相信你一定會成為出色的鐵匠！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You mean...
You didn't get
a receipt?
What...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你的意思是...
你沒拿到收據？
什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
A receipt is
a Merchant's best friend!
It's necessary to your job!
You'll have to start your
test all over again!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
收據可是商人最好的朋友！
做生意少不了它！
你的考驗得從頭再來一遍！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Return when you
find the receipt~
You didn't forget
to receive a receipt.
Right...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
找到收據再回來吧~
你沒忘記要收據吧？
對吧...？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Thank you
very much
your help.
Return to Einbroch
and see ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
真是太感謝你幫忙了。
回艾音布羅克找^8E6B23阿爾蒂雷根^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm...?
You already finished
your test here with me!
And surprisingly, I don't
need any more help, today.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯...？
你已經通過我這裡的考驗了！
而且難得的是，我今天也沒什麼事需要幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Being
a Blacksmith
is truly great!
Don't you think so?
Mwahahahahah!!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
當鐵匠真是太棒了！
你不覺得嗎？
Mwahahahahah!!

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh, hello!
Have you come
to deliver my
Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
哦，你好！
你是來送我訂的言靈魔杖的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You sure this is what I ordered, right? I mean, if it's been used,
I don't want it.
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
你確定這就是我訂的那把吧？
我是說，用過的我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is one of the items I use...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，這是我自己用的裝備...

scripts.text: I'm sure! It's brand new!
scripts.translation: 我確定！是全新的！

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Well...
I guess I can
wait a little longer.
Please hurry with
my delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
好吧...
那我就再等等。
請儘快把我訂的貨送來~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You're
absolutely sure?
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
你真的確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you so much for traveling all the way here. That Geschupenschte, please smack him for me when you meet him for being so late on this order...
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
謝謝你大老遠跑來送貨。
那個格舒彭什特，訂單拖了這麼久，你見到他時，替我揍他一頓...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Please wait
a second, let
me give you a receipt~
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
稍等一下，我給你開張收據~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Here it is.
Thank you so much!
Oh, and good luck~
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
給你。
非常感謝！
哦，祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you
so much for
the delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
謝謝你幫忙送貨~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh...
It's been a while
since I've been
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
哦...
我好久沒去艾爾貝塔了。

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I ordered something
from there a while ago,
but I haven't received
my delivery...
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
前些日子我在那裡訂了東西，到現在還沒送來...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I wonder...
Could the Blacksmith Guild
be undermanned? I can't think of any other reason for them to be late...
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
難道...
鐵匠公會人手不夠？
除了這個，我也想不出他們遲遲不送貨的原因...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
When will I get
my special Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜蘇利斯特]
我什麼時候才能收到特製的言靈魔杖呢？

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...!
It's here!
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
...！
終於到了！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
This is what I ordered, right?
I don't want any used or old Gladius that you might have!
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
這就是我訂的那把吧？
你身上那些用過的舊長柄短劍，我可不要！

scripts.text: Whoops, not that one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，不是那把

scripts.text: I guarantee you it is new.
scripts.translation: 我保證是全新的

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oooh...!
Hurry up
with my Gladius~
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
Oooh...!
快把我的長柄短劍送來~

scripts.text: - She seems to be upset. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起來很生氣。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Hah hah hah!
Finally! Now...
Let me have
a look!
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
Hah hah hah!
終於來了！
那麼...讓我看看！

scripts.text: - She looks very happy. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起來很高興。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Are you with the
Einbroch Blacksmith Guild?
Give this message to Geschupenschte!
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
你是艾音布羅克鐵匠公會的人嗎？
替我給格舒彭什特帶個話！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
'^660000You're late!
Do you know how long
I've been waiting?!^000000'
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
“^660000你送貨太慢了！
知道我等了多久嗎？！^000000”

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
But, this is also
a masterfully crafted item.
Tell him I'm satisfied with the quality of the workmanship.
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
不過，這件東西做得確實精良。
告訴他，我對做工很滿意。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Here's the receipt.
I think you did
a good job.
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
這是收據。
我覺得你做得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Thanks for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
謝謝你幫忙送貨。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
......

[Wickebine]
They're late.
They're late,
they're late,
they're late~!
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
送貨太慢了。
太慢了，太慢了，太慢了~！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
How long does it take for something to ship from Geschupenschte? Usually, the Geffen Blacksmith Guild is pretty prompt...
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
格舒彭什特送個貨到底要多久？
吉芬鐵匠公會平時送貨都挺快的啊...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Ooohh...
This is very
upsetting...
scripts.translation:
[維克貝恩]
Ooohh...
真讓人心煩...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ohhhhhh~
Is it here?
Very nice.
Let me take a look.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
Ohhhhhh~
貨到了嗎？
很好。
讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
So you're sure this is the item
I ordered, right? I wouldn't want it if it's been used.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你確定這就是我訂的東西吧？
用過的我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this one is used!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，這把是用過的！

scripts.text: It was just made, so it's new.
scripts.translation: 剛做好的，是全新的

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Hmmmmm!
Please deliver
the right sword!
I've been waiting
long enough already...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
Hmmmmm!
請把我訂的那把劍送來！
我已經等得夠久了...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
You double checked?
Alright then, I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你確認過了？
好吧，我收下！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Oh ho...
This is good.
Much better than
what I expected.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
哦呵呵...
不錯。
比我預期的要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
With this sword...
My special moves will be even more powerful! I may even be able to perfect my fast attacking techniques! I love it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
有了這把劍...
我的絕招會更厲害！
說不定還能讓我的快攻技巧達到完美！
我太喜歡了！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Okay then.
Let me give
you a receipt.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
好，那我給你開張收據。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Here is
your receipt.
Thank you for
your business!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
這是你的收據。
感謝惠顧！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Thank you
for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
謝謝你幫忙送貨。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
......

[Krongast]
When will the sword
I ordered finally arrive?
I need to try my ultimate skill, ^2F4F4FFine Edge^000000 with it.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
我訂的劍到底什麼時候才能到？
我還要用它試試我的終極絕招——^2F4F4F利刃^000000呢。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ahhhhhhh!
I need to
have that sword!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
Ahhhhhhh!
我一定要拿到那把劍！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Oh~
Is it finally here?
The package I ordered?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
哦~
我訂的包裹終於到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Um, this is what I ordered, right? I don't want an Arbalest that's been used before.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
嗯，這就是我訂的東西吧？
用過的埃布林雷弓我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is a used one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，這把是用過的

scripts.text: I'm sure it's new.
scripts.translation: 我確定是全新的

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Hmmmm.
Please hurry
and bring the
correct item.
I've waited too
long already...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
Hmmmm.
請趕快把我訂的東西送來。
我已經等得太久了...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
So, you're sure?
Let me take a look...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
你確定吧？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
*wheet whoo*
Very nice!!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
*wheet whoo*
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
This is truly a quality made custom item. I love how there is a case for an eye patch! I really reallly love this~
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
這件定製裝備的做工真不錯。
居然還有個放眼罩的盒子，太合我心意了！
我真是太喜歡了~

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Thank you!
For something of this quality,
I can even sell it for a high price even after I've used it!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
謝謝！
品質這麼好的東西，就算我用過了，也能賣個好價錢！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Here!
Please take
your receipt.
I really appreciate
your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
給！
請收好收據。
辛苦你了，真是非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Really,
I can't say it
enough. This is
top quality work~!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
真的，再怎麼誇也不為過。
這做工真是一流~！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Eh...
When will my
order arrive?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
呃...
我訂的東西什麼時候才能到？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
A custom made Arbalest
with a quality case to hold your eye patches. Only one person can make something like that...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
定製的埃布林雷弓，還配有放眼罩的精美盒子。
這種東西只有一個人做得出來...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Ahhhhhh...
The waiting
is unbearable!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾皮茲]
Ahhhhhh...
這樣等下去實在受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Sweet God...
Have you sent
an angel...?
Is that the Ring Pommel Saber
I ordered? It's my only hope...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
上帝啊...
是您派天使來了嗎...？
那是我訂的圓柄馬刀嗎？
那可是我唯一的希望...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Huuuk*^000000 This is what I ordered, right? I needed one especially
made to stop this poison...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
^666666*Huuuk*^000000這就是我訂的那把吧？
我是特意定製來解毒的...

scripts.text: Whoops, this is my own Ring Pommel Saber.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，這是我自己的圓柄馬刀

scripts.text: I'm sure this is the one.
scripts.translation: 我確定就是這把

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
N-Nooo...
Hurry...!
I need that
sword for its
an...ti...d-dote!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
不、不行...
快點...！
我需要那把劍來解...解...毒！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like
he's slowly dying...!
You'd better hurry.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他好像正在慢慢死去...！
你最好快點。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghklk*^000000
Give it...!
Pleeeease!

^3355FFBismarc stabs
himself, repeatedly,
with the Ring Pommel Saber
that has been imbued with
the power of Green Herbs.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF俾斯麥用那把蘊含綠色藥草之力的圓柄馬刀，一次又一次刺向自己。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
*Gasp gasp*
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
*Gasp gasp*

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Please...
Help me up.
The poison is
still coarsing
through my body...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
請...
扶我起來。
毒素還在我體內肆虐...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
OwwwWWWW!!
IT'S BURNING!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
OwwwWWWW!!
燒起來了！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
*Gasp Gasp*
*Whew* Okay,
I can feel the
antidote working now.
Just what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
*Gasp Gasp*
*Whew*好了，我能感覺到解毒劑開始起作用了。
正是我需要的。

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Here is
your receipt.
T-take it...!
It's yours!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
這是你的收據。
拿、拿著...！
給你的！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Thank you.
You saved
my life...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
謝謝你。
你救了我的命...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
^666666*Huk Hukk*^000000
When will my
o-order arrive...?
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
^666666*Huk Hukk*^000000
我訂...訂的東西什麼時候才能到...？

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
The poison in
my body... the pain...
excruciating... L-lord...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
我體內的毒...痛得...受不了了...
主、主啊...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
When is the
antidote gonna
get here?!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麥]
解毒劑到底什麼時候才能到？！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Oh...so you're the one who wants to be a blacksmith?
Nice, heh heh.
As you've realized from your past tests, you won't be promoted from Merchant to Blacksmtih immediately.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
哦...你就是想當鐵匠的人啊？
不錯，呵呵。
經過前面的考驗，你也知道了，商人可不是說轉職就能成為鐵匠的。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
How much do you truly understand about smithing? Are you ready for me to ask you some questions?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
你對鍛造究竟瞭解多少？
準備好讓我提問了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, not yet~
scripts.translation: 不，還沒準備好~

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Alright...
My test is simple.
I'll ask five questions.
If you miss too many,
you fail. And I won't
tell you what you missed.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
好...
我的考驗很簡單，就問五道題。
錯得太多就不及格。
而且我不會告訴你錯了哪幾道。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Please listen
and answer carefully...
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
請仔細聽題，認真作答...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
1. What ability
is required to learn
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
1. 學習^8E6B23低價買進^000000需要先學會什麼技能？

scripts.text: Level 3 Push Cart
scripts.translation: 3級手推車使用

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鑑定

scripts.text: Level 10 Mammonite
scripts.translation: 10級金錢攻擊

scripts.text: Level 3 Enlarge Weight
scripts.translation: 3級負重量上升

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
2. When you attack
with ^8E6B23Hammerfall^000000,
what status effect can
you inflict on enemies?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
2. 用^8E6B23大地之擊^000000攻擊，可以讓敵人陷入什麼異常狀態？

scripts.text: Stun
scripts.translation: 眩暈

scripts.text: Blindness
scripts.translation: 黑暗

scripts.text: Chaos
scripts.translation: 混亂

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
3. How much Zeny is spent
when attacking with the
mastered Mammonite skill?
(Level 10 Mammonite)
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
3. 使用滿級金錢攻擊時，每次攻擊會消耗多少Zeny？
（10級金錢攻擊）

scripts.text: 900 Zeny
scripts.translation: 900 Zeny

scripts.text: 1000 Zeny

[Mitehmaeeuh]

你得了{0}分...

先回去好好學學，再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
However, don't let your early success make you overconfident. A Blacksmith's life isn't a picnic. As proof that you have passed the test, I give you this Hammer of Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
不過，可別因為這點成功就得意忘形。
鐵匠的生活可不輕鬆。
這個高階鐵砧就給你，作為通過考驗的證明。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Take this Hammer
of Blacksmith and go back to the Altiregen. Okay then? I wish you the best of luck!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
帶著這個高階鐵砧回阿爾蒂雷根那裡去，好嗎？
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
With your knowledge, or lack thereof, you'll just end up hurting yourself holding a hammer!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
就你這點知識——或者說，你根本沒學到什麼——拿起錘子只會傷到自己！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Okay then.
Please prepare
yourself and return
when you are ready...

[米特梅烏]
好，那你先去準備，準備好了再回來...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
I had to deal with the heat when I was in Morocc,
and now I have to deal with the smog in this Einbroch!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
在夢羅克時得忍受酷熱，到了艾音布羅克，又得忍受煙霧！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
But, I must admit that this is the perfect place for Blacksmiths because we have an abundance of crafting material supplies as well as highly developed equipment.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
不過，我得承認，這裡確實是鐵匠的理想之地。
材料供應充足，裝置也很先進。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
We, Blacksmiths are trying our best to forge the best of the best weapons.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
我們鐵匠一直竭盡全力，要鍛造出最頂尖的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
We pledge our honor on that!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅烏]
我們以榮譽擔保！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Good day, are you here to visit Blacksmith Guild?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
你好，你是來參觀鐵匠公會的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I thank you for coming this far to visit our guild. However, I regret to inform you that Blacksmith Guild has been
moved to ^3131FF'Einbroch' in the Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
感謝您遠道而來參觀公會。
不過，很遺憾，鐵匠公會已經搬到^3131FF修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的“艾音布羅克”^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
You can travel to Schwarzwald Republic by using the airship.
I can provide you a teleport service to Izlude, where you can use the airship.
Would you like to move to Izlude immediately?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
您可以乘坐飛空艇前往修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國。
我可以把您傳送到依斯魯得島，那裡就能搭乘飛空艇。
您要現在前往依斯魯得島嗎？

scripts.text: How to go to Einbroch
scripts.translation: 如何前往艾音布羅克

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 好！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Oops, haven't you used the airship yet?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
哎呀，您還沒坐過飛空艇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Unlike Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic has 'the airship' instead of teleport services to move between towns.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
和盧恩·米德加茲王國不同，修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的城鎮間交通不是靠傳送服務，而是靠飛空艇。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
In ^3131FF'Izlude'^000000, you can use ^3131FF'the international airship'^000000 which travels between ^3131FFIzlude and Juno in Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
在^3131FF依斯魯得島^000000，您可以搭乘^3131FF國際飛空艇^000000，往返於^3131FF依斯魯得島和修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的朱諾^000000之間。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Take the airship, and go to Juno. Then from Juno, you need to take ^3131FFthe domestic airship^000000 to go to Einbroch.
Remember, you are ^3131FFnot going outside of the airport^000000 upon transit from the international to the domestic airship.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
先乘飛空艇到朱諾，再換乘^3131FF國內飛空艇^000000前往艾音布羅克。
記住，從國際飛空艇換乘國內飛空艇時，^3131FF不要走出機場^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
It might sound complicated, but you will know once you are in the airport.
When you arrive in Blacksmith Guild, please send my regard to my coworkers!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
聽起來可能有點複雜，不過到了機場，您就明白了。
到鐵匠公會後，請代我向同事們問好！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Excuse me, but you do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
抱歉，您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Please take care!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
請多保重！
